courses.subject: HSYS
courses.title: Public Private Partnerships in Health
courses.description: This course examines existing approaches towards Public Private partnerships in healthcare and aims at providing tools that will help them to understand health policies that involve the private sector. It will provide students with a framework both for analyzing the opportunities for Public Private Partnership in a health system as well as for designing strategies and approaches for engaging the private sector.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in Master of Public Health
courses.learning_outcomes: This course examines existing approaches towards Public Private partnerships in healthcare and aims at providing tools that will help them to understand health policies that involve the private sector. It will provide students with a framework both for analyzing the opportunities for Public Private Partnership in a health system as well as for designing strategies and approaches for engaging the private sector.

courses.subject: HSYS
courses.title: Patient-Centred Health System
courses.description: The course will introduce students to the principles and practices of patient-centred care, and application of design thinking concepts in the development towards a patient-centred health system.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in Master of Public Health, Master of Science in Health Services Management and Postgraduate diploma in Health Services Management
courses.learning_outcomes:
Student should be able to:

1. Understand the meaning, principles, and practices in patient-centred healthcare.
2. Learn the principles and application of design thinking in patient-centred design.
3. Understand the implications of civil society engagement and collaborative governance in the development towards a patient-centred health system.
courses.course_syllabus: The course includes the topics of Patient Experience, Patient Communication, Patient Co-design and Patient Advocacy.
